item.title: How many things did I do during lockdown
item.description: Chesca Kirkland recorded her life during lockdown, things about her daily activities such as how many showers she took, whether or not she meditated or how many people she meet. After that she created this series of infographics to represent those activities in a visual and more inmediate form.
